Y-axis label '2k' is visible but other scale values are missing or unclear

Chart lacks gridlines, axis lines, or baseline reference, making it look incomplete

top_fixes: Add value labels (12k, 18k, 15k, 24k, 29k, 33k) above each bar as explicitly requested
Increase font size of x-axis month labels (Jan-Jun) to be clearly readable
Make all six bars the same color for visual consistency, or use a deliberate gradient if variation is intended
